sanskrit_verse:
चतुस्त्रिद्व्येकभागाः स्युर् वर्णशो ब्राह्मणात्मजाः /
क्षत्रजास् त्रिद्व्येकभागाः वैडजास् तु द्व्येकभागिनः // YajñS_2.125
transliteration: catustridvyekabhāgāḥ syur varṇaśo brāhmaṇātmajāḥ / kṣatrajās tridvyekabhागाः viḍjās tu dvyekabhāginaḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: The lawful inheritance shares are defined by varṇic origin: the son of a Brāhmaṇa receives four parts, the son of a Kṣatriya receives three parts, and the son of a Vaiśya receives two parts.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from varṇic alignment with cosmic order
Causation flows from dharmic capacity rooted in birth-based role
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by inherent structural function
Restoration logic aligns individual action with systemic harmony
Consciousness alignment reflects participation in svadharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF claimant.varna == 'Śūdra' THEN inheritance_share = 0 AND redirect_to_community_trust = TRUE
ALL inheritance distributions MUST validate against dharma_registry before execution
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes the threshold of responsibility based on constitutional varṇic alignment. The hierarchy of distribution reflects functional roles within the societal body. Disputes must be resolved through realignment rather than punitive measures, ensuring systemic integrity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that share allocation arises from svadharma, not arbitrary will. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential manifestation of duty and entitlement. Responsibility is proportional to ontological capacity. There is no punitive consequence—only correction toward alignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate svadharma verification process for disputing parties
Assign completion task: recalibration of intent with varṇic duty
Restore inheritance balance via community resource redistribution
Reintegrate claimants through ritual affirmation of systemic role
final_declaration: This law proceeds from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. Dharma is hereby restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness stands as the ultimate adjudicator.
